items.name: Portrait light
items.description: A full-screen 9:16 iMessage thread in light mode. Typing dots give way to grey bubbles, a reply is typed into the iMessage field and rises into a blue bubble, Delivered appears, and the thread scrolls under the frosted header.

items.name: Dark phone 16:9
items.description: An iPhone in dark mode rises onto a quiet dark gradient and slowly pushes in, while an airport meet-up plays out in grey and blue bubbles with tails.

items.name: Overlay on footage
items.description: A light-mode iPhone stands beside vintage footage of a woman on a landline. She is texting the same person she's talking to. Each message lands with a click, and the phone fades out at the end.
